description: This file defines a YAML schema for a class representing backhaul station MLD configuration, including nested structures, bit fields, and references to external types and classes within the project.

classes.name: tlvBackhaulStaMldConfiguration
classes.description: Main class representing backhaul station MLD configuration with properties such as address validity, modes, and affiliated stations.

classes.name: cAffiliatedBhSta
classes.description: Class representing an affiliated backhaul station with MAC addresses and validation info.

classes.name: sAddrValid
classes.description: Structure indicating validity bits for MAC addresses.

classes.name: sModes
classes.description: Structure with flags indicating various modes enabled/disabled.

classes.name: sAffiliatedBhStaMacAddrValid
classes.description: Structure representing validity status of an affiliated station's MAC address.
